title: Role-Based Access Control System Implementation

problem_statement.description: Need to implement role-based access control for certain pages to restrict access to Admin and Moderator Discord roles only
requirements: Protect specific pages from unauthorized access
Integrate with existing Discord OAuth2 system
Maintain public access to most pages
Prevent back navigation after access denial
constraints: Must work with existing Discord authentication

solution_implementation.overview: Implemented client-side role-based access control using JavaScript with Discord OAuth2 integration

implementation_flow: 2. Check if current page is in protected_pages array
3. If protected, extract Discord ID from session/localStorage
4. Make API call to fetch user roles
5. Compare user roles with admin_roles array
6. Grant access or display access denied page

key_functions.isProtectedPage: Checks if current page requires role verification
key_functions.getDiscordId: Extracts Discord ID from window.sessionDiscordId or localStorage
key_functions.checkAdminRole: Async function that fetches and verifies user roles
key_functions.blockAccess: Replaces page content with access denied message
key_functions.init: Main initialization function called on DOMContentLoaded

integration_points.discord_oauth2: Uses existing Discord OAuth2 flow from profile.html
integration_points.api_endpoint: Integrates with existing user profile API

pages_tested: Unauthorized access - Blocked with custom UI

deployment_notes.file_permissions: All files set to public read access
deployment_notes.cdn_dependencies: Tailwind CSS via CDN for styling

lessons_learned: Client-side role verification provides good UX while maintaining security
Centralized Discord link management prevents broken links
Environment variables enable easy deployment configuration
Session-based user identification works well with Discord OAuth2
Configurable role arrays allow easy permission management
future_considerations: Consider server-side role verification for enhanced security
Implement role caching to reduce API calls
Add audit logging for access attempts
Add support for custom role requirements per page
related_functionality: HDR art gallery with fullscreen viewer

regular_checks: Verify Discord invite code is still active
Test role-based access on protected pages
update_procedures: Update DISCORD_INVITE_CODE environment variable for new invites
Modify admin_roles array in role-gate.js for role changes
Add/remove pages from protected_pages array as needed
Update fallback invite code in discord-config.js

performance_impact.client_side: Minimal - single API call per protected page load

limitations: Client-side implementation (can be bypassed by advanced users)
recommendations: Consider server-side role verification for critical pages
Implement role caching to reduce API dependency
Add rate limiting for role verification requests
